subject.title: [Bug]: Isolated cron agentTurn fails with 'setup timed out before runner start' — all fallback models exhausted on 2026.5.12

question: Should OpenClaw accept the bounded longer isolated-cron setup watchdog from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96219 as the canonical fix for this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but changing the default setup window from a fixed 60s ceiling to a longer bounded budget affects cron capacity and stuck-setup recovery behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded watchdog
options.body: Land the current PR after maintainer acceptance that slow-but-healthy isolated setup may use more of the job timeout budget.

options.title: Tighten the cap first
options.body: Ask the PR author to reduce the maximum setup window or add more runtime proof before accepting the availability tradeoff.

options.title: Require a config proposal
options.body: Defer the fix until maintainers approve an operator-tunable config surface despite the repository's high bar for new cron config.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded watchdog
recommendation.body: Land the current PR after maintainer acceptance that slow-but-healthy isolated setup may use more of the job timeout budget.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merge history shows this owner handled adjacent cron setup-timeout and timeout-attribution changes.
